literal_source_claim_zh: Hamilton圈存在的连通度与独立数条件
literal_source_claim_en: A connectivity and independence-number condition for the existence of a Hamiltonian cycle.
source_attribution: Vaclav Chvatal and Paul Erdos, 1972 (catalog metadata corroborated by the located primary paper)
canonical_statement: Let G be a graph with at least three vertices. If, for some s, G is s-connected and contains no independent set of more than s vertices, then G has a Hamiltonian circuit.
canonical_claim: Every finite graph on at least three vertices whose vertex connectivity is at least s and whose independence number is at most s is Hamiltonian, for the source-selected parameter and graph conventions.
source_candidate_statement_selected_as_c: Chvatal and Erdos 1972, Theorem 1, printed page 111.
source_candidate_locator: V. Chvatal and P. Erdos, A note on Hamiltonian circuits, Discrete Mathematics 2(2) (1972), 111-113, Theorem 1 on printed page 111, DOI 10.1016/0012-365X(72)90079-9
statement_blocker: The primary paper does not define s-connected locally and instead invokes Dirac's generalized Menger theorem. Before exact Lean elaboration, reviewers must audit the incorporated vertex-connectivity convention and parameter domain, then freeze the finite simple-graph encoding, at-least-three premise, ordered binders, independence-bound representation, Hamiltonicity convention, transports, and boundary cases. Edge connectivity is not a substitute.
